scope: Replace SQL substring filtering with indexed literal namespace ranges. Preserve delivery, polling cadence, frame pacing and persistence ownership.

commands.command: BBOXY_CACHE_MODE=off make fmt-power test-power check-power profile-power

acceptance.regressions: Identity unit, messaging and messaging_flow suites pass; strict mux/app all-target Clippy passes.

formal: No concurrency/lifecycle/state machine change; existing finite delivery models remain. Coverage maps SQL sources and specialized migration/query-work controls explicitly. Full formal checks refresh at final HEAD.
limits: Query/CPU measurements do not claim watts or battery life.
Running backend received the compatible outbox index only; changed namespace-read code loads on its next normal logic start. No sessions killed or reset.
Full exact-source CI, signed push, installation and installed smoke follow.
